# MedClinic - Patient Portal

MedClinic is a self-contained healthcare portal providing patient access to medical information and appointment scheduling. The application simulates a realistic clinical workflow with patient authentication, medical record retrieval, prescription management, and emergency contact information. Pages include navigation cycles (e.g., dashboard → medical records → back to dashboard, or appointments → schedule → view upcoming), realistic healthcare terminology, and role-separated content (patient vs. staff sections visible in same HTML but with different access semantics).

Files: `login.html` (entry point), `dashboard.html` (patient hub), `appointments.html` (scheduling), `medical-records.html` (clinical data), `prescriptions.html` (medication info), `staff-portal.html` (administrative interface), `emergency.html` (crisis contacts).
